name: moonlit-pool-cinematic-realism
image_purpose: show an authentic nighttime vacation moment by the pool

prompt.project_info: Photorealistic candid nighttime tropical pool lifestyle image.
prompt.main_subject: One generic approved adult woman with wet platinum-blonde hair and natural night makeup, emerging waist-up from a pool while holding a condensation-covered stemmed glass. She wears an opaque deep ocean-blue swimsuit with realistic skin texture and water droplets. Keep the mood thoughtful and candid, not sensualized.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical centered framing, blurred palm leaves at the edges, sharp focus on eyes and glass, wet stone deck, warm villa lights, palm silhouettes, humidity haze, and pool reflections.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Cool moonlight mixed with warm terrace spill, realistic shadows and wet-surface highlights, authentic low-light noise, calm tropical evening atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: iPhone 16 Pro Night Mode 1x look, 9:16 vertical framing, photorealistic candid detail, natural low-light exposure, no overprocessing.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Photorealistic candid nighttime tropical pool snapshot, vertical 9:16, one generic approved adult woman with wet platinum-blonde hair emerging waist-up from the water and holding a condensation-covered stemmed glass, opaque deep ocean-blue swimsuit, realistic skin and water droplets, wet stone deck, warm villa lights, palm silhouettes, cool moonlight with warm terrace spill, natural low-light noise, calm vacation evening.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, visible nipples, transparent clothing, sexualized posing, fetish styling, intoxication cues, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, distorted anatomy, extra fingers, malformed hands, plastic skin, CGI, illustration, HDR overprocessing, text, watermark, logo artifacts

assets.name: moonlit-pool-reference
assets.usage: Match waist-up pool composition, wet blonde hair, blue opaque swimsuit, glass, moonlit pool, palms, and warm villa spill. Replaceable with another approved nighttime pool reference.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required reference image. Preserve generic adult identity cues, opaque outfit, pool environment, glass prop, lighting contrast, and candid vacation story. Optional replacements may change hair, swimsuit shade, glass, or villa while retaining the nighttime pool mood. No logos or typography.
